newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: NWE oil products unchanged and lifeless.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products unchanged and lifeless.

text.p: NWE oil products barely changed on Monday in lifeless trading, dealers said.
Gasoline barges were offered at $194 fob AR, but no bids were forthcoming. The two trading houses which dominated trading last week were not in the market.
Heating oil barges were barely changed as IPE July gas oil futures shuffled from flat to 25 cents down. Premiums were also steady. Prompt deliveries were at IPE July evens fob Rotterdam.
High sulphur fuel oil were untraded. Offers were at $87.50 fob Rotterdam with bids $1 below.
